actuator.gap_pos_note: = blowout_pos - air_gap. Armed IN AIR before descending.
actuator.post_asp_backoff_note: extra retract in air after leaving the water, anti-drip
actuator.stroke_margin_note: keep POS at least this far off the POS=0 hard stop

calibration.note: Store coefficients ONLY. Displacements are computed at runtime. No mm value is ever typed into a protocol script.

prewet.asp_pos_note: = blowout_pos - displacement_mm, measured from BOTTOMED, not from gap_pos

tube_rack_0p65_5x10.note: was marked <-- TUNE in the source and was never tuned

tiprack_300_96.note: pick=59.0 comes from the direct rack measurement and supersedes the old Z_TIP_PICK=57.5 in examples/300ulaccuracyprecision.py. Confirm 57.5 was not a different tip type.

sbs_96_wellplate.note: UNMEASURED. Commanded Z to dispense into a 96-well plate well with a 300 uL tip fitted. Effector.z_for raises an EffectorError naming this field while it is null, which is what makes protocols/centrifuge_test.py refuse to generate rather than invent a depth.

tube_rack_1p5.note: UNMEASURED, both. 'work' is the dispense depth in a 1.5 mL tube; 'bottom' is the deeper position Machine.mix cycles at, so that a mix turns the contents over instead of stirring the surface. bottom must be deeper (numerically LARGER, since +Z is down) than work.
